Internal mobility and targeted certifications might offset regional talent scarcity, allowing the Group to meet surging demand across defense and enterprise accounts. responses.action: Prepare contingency engineering programs to redesign legacy boards around readily available commercial memory architectures

signposts.text: SK Hynix or Micron declares force majeure on non-AI memory contract shipments.
Major electronics manufacturers announce production curbs due to memory shortages.
Component suppliers introduce strict rationing programs for standard microcontrollers and memory modules.

counter_indicators.text: Global smartphone and PC manufacturers report rising inventories and declining component procurement costs.
